data.description: Discover luxury and tranquility in Jumeirah Island Townhouses, Dubai’s exclusive waterfront community.

data.answer:
Jumeirah Island Townhouses provide residents with convenient access to a variety of communal and recreational facilities, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals. The community features beautifully landscaped gardens with serene views of the man-made lake, creating a peaceful environment for residents to enjoy. The townhouses are strategically located around the eastern and western sides of the Jumeirah Islands, offering easy access to nearby amenities such as dining, shopping, and fitness centers.

The community is equipped with top-notch facilities, including round-the-clock security, outdoor sports areas, and well-maintained parks, ensuring a high standard of living for its residents. Additionally, the development is well-connected to major roads and public transport options, making it easy for residents to commute to Dubai’s key business districts and leisure attractions.

The properties in Jumeirah Island Townhouses primarily feature luxurious 4-bedroom villas that offer spacious interiors and modern architectural designs. These townhouses come with stunning views of the surrounding landscapes and are perfect for families seeking a comfortable and upscale living environment. With ample space for entertainment, relaxation, and daily comfort, Jumeirah Island Townhouses properties offer an ideal blend of elegance and practicality, making them a top choice for those looking for premium townhouses for sale in Dubai.

Properties for Rent in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Jumeirah Island Townhouses offers a variety of rental options for families and professionals. The starting price for a 4-bedroom townhouse for rent typically ranges from AED 250,000 to AED 300,000 annually. These properties are ideal for those looking to enjoy luxury living in a peaceful and well-connected community.

Properties for Sale in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

The townhouses in this community are available for sale, with prices starting from AED 4.5 million for a 4-bedroom villa. These properties are considered a premium investment due to their location, amenities, and potential for capital appreciation.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

data.answer:
Living in Jumeirah Island Townhouses offers residents a peaceful and luxurious lifestyle. The community is surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens, lakes, and walkways, providing a serene environment for families. Residents can also enjoy access to world-class amenities such as swimming pools, fitness centers, and sports facilities. With its prime location, excellent connectivity, and luxurious properties, Jumeirah Island Townhouses is the perfect choice for those seeking an exclusive living experience in Dubai.

Moreover, the prime location of Jumeirah Island Townhouses ensures excellent connectivity to Dubai's key business districts and entertainment hubs. Residents benefit from easy access to major roads and public transport, making commuting effortless and convenient. Whether it's shopping at nearby malls, dining at world-class restaurants, or enjoying outdoor activities, the lifestyle in Jumeirah Island Townhouses perfectly balances luxury living with the conveniences of city life.

Public Transportation in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Residents of Jumeirah Island Townhouses have access to a range of public transportation options, making commuting around Dubai convenient. Several bus stops are located within a 9-minute drive from the community, offering easy access to various parts of the city. For those who prefer the metro, both DMCC Metro Station and Sobha Realty Metro Station are just a 6-minute drive away. Additionally, taxis are readily available in the area, and popular ride-hailing apps provide an alternative for quick and efficient transport.

Supermarkets in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Residents of Jumeirah Island Townhouses can enjoy the convenience of Choithrams Supermarket, located in the Jumeirah Islands Pavilion, just a short walk away. This supermarket offers a wide selection of fresh produce, baked goods, and everyday essentials, making it a preferred shopping destination for the community. For additional grocery options, Big Buy Market and Madhoor Supermarket are also nearby, ensuring residents have access to a variety of shopping choices within a few minutes' drive.

Shopping Malls in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Jumeirah Islands Townhouses is conveniently located just a short drive from Jumeirah Island Townhouses, offering residents access to a variety of dining options, a supermarket, and other essential services. This nearby hub provides everyday conveniences without the need to travel far.

For a more extensive shopping experience, residents can visit Ibn Battuta Mall, Dubai's largest themed mall, just 10 minutes away by car. Other popular shopping destinations nearby include Dubai Marina Mall and Jumeirah Park Pavilion, both offering a wide range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities for the whole family.

Schools in and Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Schools near Jumeirah Island Townhouses include several top-rated institutions, offering a variety of curricula to cater to the diverse educational needs of residents. Dubai British School Jumeirah Park is just a short drive away, known for its excellent academic standards and modern facilities. 

Another nearby option is Emirates International School – Meadows, offering a comprehensive international curriculum that prepares students for global success. For those seeking a more specialized academic environment, Dubai International Academy is also within close proximity, providing the prestigious International Baccalaureate (IB) program. Each of these schools ensures a high-quality education for children of all ages, making Jumeirah Island Townhouses an ideal location for families.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Places of worship near Jumeirah Island Townhouses offer a variety of religious services. Churches nearby include Christ Church Jebel Ali, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, and St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church, all of which are located within a 15-minute drive. Additionally, Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara and the Hindu Temple can be reached within 20 minutes, providing options for Sikh and Hindu residents.

For Muslim residents, several mosques are conveniently located within a short drive. Bani Hashim Mosque, Masjid Ale Imran, and Al Wahhab Mosque are all within a 10-minute drive from the community, ensuring easy access to daily prayers and religious gatherings.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Residents of Jumeirah Island Townhouses have easy access to several healthcare facilities nearby, ensuring prompt medical care when needed. Notable options include Mediclinic Meadows, Laven Clinic, and HealthHub Clinic and Pharmacy, all conveniently located within a 10-minute drive from the community. These clinics provide a range of medical services, from general healthcare to specialized treatments, ensuring that residents can find quality care close to home.

Jumeirah Island Townhouses Location & Nearby Areas

Jumeirah Island Townhouses is surrounded by several prestigious residential communities, offering residents easy access to some of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Neighboring communities include Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), known for its vibrant lifestyle and waterfront views, and Dubai Marina, a hub for luxury living and entertainment. Additionally, residents are close to The Springs, a family-friendly community, and Emirates Hills, a high-end residential area. Other nearby areas include Jumeirah Heights and Meadows Dubai, both offering a mix of upscale living and tranquility, making Jumeirah Island Townhouses an ideal location for luxury and convenience.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

data.answer:

The community offers high-end townhouses with premium amenities, making it perfect for residents who prioritize comfort and elegance. As a luxury development, the property prices are on the higher side, catering to those looking for an upscale living experience. If you are searching for more budget-friendly options, other communities in Dubai might be worth exploring.

Restaurants In and Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Jumeirah Island Townhouses offer convenient access to a variety of dining options, with plenty of restaurants nearby serving diverse cuisines to cater to different tastes. Popular spots include The Hamptons Café, known for its charming ambiance, and Circle Café, a go-to for casual dining. 

For those looking for a more upscale experience, Sal’s Bistro and The Cavendish Restaurant provide elegant settings and gourmet meals. Additionally, Karam Beirut Street Kitchen offers a taste of authentic Lebanese cuisine. All these dining options are within a quick 10-minute drive, making it easy for residents to enjoy a wide range of culinary delights.

Beaches Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Since Jumeirah Island Townhouses is conveniently located near Dubai's coastline, residents have easy access to some of the city's best beaches. Popular destinations like Marina Beach and JBR Beach are just a short drive away, offering perfect spots for a day of relaxation or adventure. Visitors can enjoy a variety of watersports, dine at renowned beachside restaurants, or simply unwind on the soft, sandy shores.

Hotels in Jumeirah Island Townhouses

For visitors or those looking for a staycation, there are several luxury hotels near Jumeirah Island Townhouses. These include the Address Montgomerie, just 10 minutes away, known for its golf course and serene surroundings. Another nearby option is The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai, located 15 minutes away, offering beachfront luxury and world-class amenities. For those seeking vibrant city views, the InterContinental Dubai Marina is a 12-minute drive, providing modern accommodations and easy access to Dubai's marina district.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Jumeirah Island Townhouses

Nearby leisure spots such as Jumeirah Islands Pavilion, Emirates Golf Club, and Jebel Ali Recreation Club provide residents with a variety of dining, recreational, and entertainment activities, all just a short drive away.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Jumeirah Island Townhouses residents can enjoy several parks nearby, featuring jogging and cycling tracks, all within a 10-minute drive. These parks offer the perfect outdoor spaces for fitness enthusiasts and families alike to unwind and stay active.

For indoor fitness, options such as Reset Fitness, The Champion Club, and Base i3 are conveniently located close to the community, providing residents with a variety of modern fitness facilities. Additionally, there are plenty of salons nearby, including The Loft Fifth Avenue, Essa Beauty, and Koza Curl, all accessible within a 10-minute drive, catering to the beauty and grooming needs of the community.

While Jumeirah Island Townhouses offers excellent connectivity, you might find traffic during peak hours on nearby Sheikh Zayed Road. Residents are advised to plan their commute accordingly, especially during school runs and rush hour.

Jumeirah Island Townhouses mainly offers luxurious 4-bedroom townhouses with spacious layouts, modern designs, and high-end finishes, catering to families and professionals seeking a premium living experience.

Jumeirah Island Townhouses enjoy excellent connectivity to major roads and public transport. It is only a short drive from popular areas like Dubai Marina, JBR, and Downtown Dubai, making commuting easy and convenient.

Is Jumeirah Island Townhouses a family-friendly community?

Absolutely, the community is designed with families in mind, offering spacious homes, child-friendly parks, and a peaceful environment. The proximity to schools, parks, and recreational facilities makes it an ideal choice for families.

What amenities are available near Jumeirah Island Townhouses?

Residents can enjoy access to various amenities, including nearby supermarkets, fitness centers, beauty salons, and dining options, all within a short driving distance from the community.

What is the starting price for buying a property in Jumeirah Island Townhouses?

data.content:
Jumeirah Island Townhouses is a sub-community within the prestigious Jumeirah Islands, offering luxurious 4-bedroom townhouses developed by Nakheel Properties. Ideally located adjacent to Al Worood 3 Street, the community provides a serene environment with easy access to the bustling parts of Dubai. The townhouses are spacious and designed to cater to modern families, offering high-end amenities and a peaceful lifestyle within a well-established neighborhood.

Developed by Nakheel, Jumeirah Island Townhouses is located close to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), providing residents with excellent connectivity to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and other key areas of the city. The community consists of 84 townhouses, each offering luxurious living spaces alongside a park, a well-equipped community center, and various retail and dining options. Essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, mosques, and fitness facilities are all conveniently located nearby, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking both comfort and convenience.

The community also features a range of recreational facilities, including a fitness center, sports courts, and beautifully landscaped parks. With its prime location, excellent amenities, and peaceful environment, Jumeirah Island Townhouses presents a perfect blend of luxury living and practicality, attracting both investors and those looking for a long-term residence in Dubai.
